text:
Sam Carter: Heads up — console route breakdown is showing ~12% of tokens as <unknown-route> for a handful of tenants since 11:10 UTC. Preview diffs look off. Anyone tracking enrichment pipeline?
Priya Nair: I noticed it too, dashboards show enrichment-latency spiking around 11:07. Might be related to the route-tagging rollout.
Marco Li: Seeing backlog on enrichment consumer. Logs:```[11:07:14] enrichment.consumer queue_length=482 processing_ms=3200 route_tag=null
[11:07:20] enrichment.consumer queue_length=501 error=Timeout reading metadata for client_id=acct-1234```
Jules Ortega: That's the metadata service retries. We pushed a change earlier lowering meta-svc max_conns from 50 -> 20 in the canary group. Could be starving enrichment.
Priya Nair: I reverted the conn limit in the canary at ~11:30 and queue dropped, but console previews still show unknown for ~10 tenants.
Sam Carter: Could be a missing fallback in the aggregator — it should fallback to the request-level route header if enrichment is delayed.
Marco Li: Confirmed: aggregator fallback only triggers when enrichment flag `allow_partial` is true. For v2 routing header the flag is false. I can patch to set allow_partial=true for short window.
Jules Ortega: :thumbsup: Safe for a temporary fix. Also we should show a banner in the console explaining "partial route attribution" so users aren't confused by preview discrepancies.
Ashley (metering-bot): Alert: enrichment-backlog-high resolved at 11:33 UTC. Reprocessed 390 events. reprocess-id=rp-202603201133
Sam Carter: Can we run a targeted reprocess for the tenants with unknown-route in 11:06-11:20 window? If invoices unaffected we can avoid billing changes.
Priya Nair: Started reprocess job rp-202603201140 targeting tenant ids [acct-1234, acct-5678, acct-9999]. ETA ~6m.
Marco Li: Patch submitted to set allow_partial=true for v2 routing fallback. PR: https://git.company/repo/commit/abcd1234 — will promote to canary at 11:40.
Jules Ortega: I'll add a short invoice-preview banner: "Route attribution partial for some requests — details on status page" and link it to the enrichment incident.
Sam Carter: After reprocess, please run a diff between preview and invoice for those tenants and paste a summary here.
Priya Nair: Reprocess done 11:47. metering-bot reports 412 events enriched. Running diff now.
Ashley (metering-bot): Reprocess rp-202603201140 completed at 11:47 UTC. enriched=412 requeued=0
Priya Nair: Diff summary: acct-1234 token delta 0. acct-5678 token delta -12 (previously unknown, now attributed to cached client header). No invoice changes expected.
Sam Carter: :tada: Great work. Action items: add health metric `enrichment.processing_lag`, surface console banner for "partial attribution" toggle, and add an alert pairing to catch metadata-service connection regressions.
Jules Ortega: I'll file the followup tasks and link the PR + reprocess ids in the postmortem.
Marco Li: I'll monitor canary and promote patch to stable once we see zero regressions for 24h.
Priya Nair: Closing the thread on our side, will update postmortem with exact tenant list and diffs.
